linkedin:
Only 23% of remote job listings show a salary figure. Our snapshot of 4,441 active remote listings found just 1,000 (23%) disclose pay, while 3,441 (77%) keep compensation private. The data also shows 2,753 listings (about 62%) accept applicants from anywhere in the world, so location is rarely the barrier—pay transparency is.

Communication is the most-requested skill (39% of 4,282 analysed listings), followed by AI at 12%, leadership at 10%, sales at 8%, project management at 7%, and data analysis at 7%. Among 1,560 companies currently hiring, only one, Neo Financial, reveals its rate (USD 5/hour).

A lack of posted pay does not necessarily mean low wages; many employers expect candidates to negotiate. If you are job hunting, filter Loker Dollar for “worldwide remote” to see the 2,753 roles open to you before listings close.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
